subject: botany_2
question_text: How many molecules of ATP and NADPH are needed to fix a molecule of CO2 in C3 plants? Where does this process occur?

verification.note: Sourced from "Sr. Botany — My Baby Bullet-Q" (Sri Publishers, STAR-Q Pass Track), book p.40, printed question 70. Botany-II holds only ONE source book: the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand covers physics only, and no Telangana Botany-II board paper is in the corpus, so the two-book union check and the board back-test are BOTH structurally impossible for this card — "not checked" does NOT mean "checked and clean". Run both the moment a second source or a real paper arrives. The mark split is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. Examiner audit revision (2026-09-05): the second mistakes entry on s2_where no longer treats the grana line as required, because the question asks only where the process occurs and the card's own insider note says nothing else is needed; it now catches the vaguer error of naming only the chloroplast.

insider_note: Two numbers and one place. Three ATP and two NADPH, in the stroma. Nothing else is needed.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The numbers
steps.margin_note: Both numbers on their own lines. This mark is arithmetic, not prose.
lines: To fix ONE molecule of carbon dioxide, a C3
steps.why: Both are made in the light reaction, so this ratio is the exact bill the dark reaction sends to the light reaction for every carbon fixed.
common_mistakes: Swapping the numbers. It is 3 ATP and 2 NADPH, not 2 and 3.
Writing NADH. It is NADPH in photosynthesis.
steps.memory_tip: Three ATP, two NADPH, one carbon.

steps.label: Where it occurs
steps.margin_note: Name the site and the source of the ATP. Four lines.

lines.text: 3 ATP + 2 NADPH per CO2, in the stroma

lines: The process occurs in the STROMA of the
The ATP and NADPH come from the light reaction
steps.why: Naming both places shows where the two reactions meet: the products of the grana are spent in the stroma.
common_mistakes: Saying it occurs in the grana. Carbon fixation happens in the STROMA.
Naming only the chloroplast. The question asks where inside it, and the answer is the STROMA.
steps.memory_tip: Made in the grana, spent in the stroma.
